title: Tidy Skies
summary: They came to clean up after us. A laser-meshed orbital swarm co-opts humanity's own cleanup fleet — and the road to the Collective is paved with environmental remediation grants.
origin: Swarm-story distillation, main chat, 2026-10-08 — Scot asked for a longer, more explanatory distillation of the orbital swarm story concept, beyond the jacket copy of 2026-10-06.

title: The Bet
summary: Two men, one free beer, and the end of money. A bet about where the future starts, with my nephew John, settling New Year's Eve 2030.
origin: The Autonimity discussions with nephew John Louie, begun over the July 2026 Musk story; the bet reconstructed over texts, 2026-11-08; terms and narrative settled in interview, 2026-11-19.

title: At Ease, Kids
summary: A misread bumper sticker becomes a sitcom. A Marine Gunnery Sergeant and martial arts instructor applies tactical discipline to her teenagers' dating lives in her final year before retirement. A contained narrative, not a pitch.
origin: A "Marine Mom" sticker, misread on a walk as a mother who IS a Marine; developed in conversation with Gemini into a full show model; combined into narrative form by Nova, 2026-11-22.

title: Christmas 2026 - a card
summary: Look deep into this card. Small doors stand open everywhere — in the ornaments, the clock, the branches — and the presents are not wrapped nearly as tightly as they look. Open them.
origin: The Deep Card: conceived and directed by Scot; twenty hidden worlds generated in Google AI Studio (Nano Banana 2 Lite) from Nova's prompts, 2026-11-20 to 2026-11-24; assembled by Scot in Photopea; the Key drawn from the card itself.

title: What a Strange Way to Live
summary: A man plays Grand Theft Auto VI through a brain implant, by imagined movement alone. From a text exchange and a headache, a prologue to the implant society, unwound down a hallway of doors.
origin: The text exchange with John Louie of 2026-11-07, in which his line gave the piece its title; reopened 2026-11-22 by the Neuralink GTA VI exhibit and rewritten through 2026-11-26.
